quote.text: No person is free who is not master of himself.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the wisdom that mastering oneself begins at home, where by modeling calm discipline and emotional balance, you guide your children to nurture their inner freedom.
    • Remember that true authority in parenting lies in the control of your own passions—by conquering anger and embracing virtue, you create a safe space for growth and genuine understanding.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, recognize that self-mastery is the cornerstone of inspiring others; only when you rule your own impulses can you effectively lead others towards a collective purpose.
    • Your decisions and actions must reflect discipline and integrity—by controlling your desires, you foster trust and encourage your team to pursue excellence with clarity and calm.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, the freedom to innovate comes from mastering your own mindset—embrace a disciplined approach to decision-making and let reason guide you through uncertain challenges.
    • Balance ambition with humility: control your inner narrative, so that even in the face of market shifts, you remain centered, open to learning, and steadfast in pursuit of product excellence.
